description: This file defines an abstract class 'RegexBasedAbstract' for dispatching HTTP requests based on route matching, part of the FastRoute library. It manages static and variable route maps, handles dispatching logic including fallback methods, and gathers allowed methods for unmatched routes.

classes.name: RegexBasedAbstract
classes.description: An abstract class that provides routing dispatch logic for HTTP requests based on static and variable routes.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP method and URI, matches against static and variable routes, including fallback for HEAD, and computes allowed methods for unmatched routes.

methods.name: dispatchVariableRoute
methods.description: Abstract method to dispatch variable routes, implemented in subclasses.
